title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Releases 1st New Volume in 22 Months on July 3
content: Shueisha published chapters 401 to 410 of the manga in its Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from issue 45 of 2024 to issue two of 2025. Togashi underwent surgery and announced that he had drafted the storyboard layouts for two more chapters of the manga in December 2024.
author: ANN

title: 5 Shonen Protagonists Who Redefined What an Anime Hero Can Be
content: Over the years, anime has developed its own identity, and due to the popularity of shonen series, the genre has come to overshadow much of the industry. Shonen anime often follows a familiar formula, from its narrative structure to its protagonists.

title: Voice Actor Katsuji Mori Cancels Stage Performance in Reading Event Due to Injury
content: Voice actor Katsuji Mori announced on his X (formerly Twitter ) account on Sunday that he will not perform on stage and will focus on directing the upcoming "Kotoba no Mori" reading performance.
author: ANN

title: Honō no Tōkyūjo: Dodge Danko Dodgeball Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast & Staff Members, Opening Song, July 6 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Tetsuhiro Koshita 's Honō no Tōkyūjo: Dodge Danko manga revealed on Monday the anime's main promotional video, additional cast and staff members, and July 6 debut.
author: ANN

title: Nao Iwamoto's The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Manga Gets TV Anime in October
content: NHK announced on Monday that Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga is getting a television anime series that will debut on NHK Educational in October.
author: ANN

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm Reveals Additional Cast Including Tenaga & Ashinaga Voices
content: Daemons of the Shadow Realm anime revealed four additional cast members including the voice actors behind Tenaga and Ashinaga. The announcement was made following the premiere of Episode 9 “Embrace and Whisper.” Studio BONES FILM is in charge of the animation, with the anime set to run for two consecutive cours .
author: Anime Corner

title: J.C.Staff Produces 'Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi' TV Anime for Fall 2026
content: Publishing company Shogakukan opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) on Monday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime will premiere on NHK E-Tele in October 2026.
